text:
Which statement about the Periodic Table is correct?
A
Elements in the same group have the same number of electron shells.
B
Elements are arranged in order of increasing proton number.
C
Metals are on the right and non-metals are on the left.
D
The most reactive elements are at the bottom of every group.

options.label: A
options.text: Elements in the same group have the same number of electron shells.

options.label: B
options.text: Elements are arranged in order of increasing proton number.

options.label: C
options.text: Metals are on the right and non-metals are on the left.

options.label: D
options.text: The most reactive elements are at the bottom of every group.
